note: outside the 12 cells: 浦の浜 (大島 ferry landing), round 3. The terminal, the pontoon and the apron are drawn in src/anime/world/landmarks/oshima.js (URANOHAMA in sites.js); this file adds what Earth 2026-03-11 shows on the land strip between the quay road and the terminal: the 緑地公園 (dormant turf with paved paths and a small paved square) and the row of small gabled tile-roof shops south of the terminal (the GSI footprints merge them into two sheds: lots 16/58548/25078/9 and /12, which keep their OSM names. The far town skips a lot under 130 m2 and draws no land use, so the five units, the park and its paths are drawn by landmarks/oshima.js from this file (the round-3 patch: it also hides the two merged lots in the far town and shrinks the apron); without that patch the units and the park do not render and only the hip roof of lot /8 changes). All positions are in the layout's ENU metres; roofs were read on the Earth top view rectified at roof height (raw/ref/earth/lm/lm-uranohama-r3, direct registration scale 0.9775) and aligned to the GSI footprints (the units 1 to 3 together are the GSI lot 16/58548/25078/9: 21.6 m long, Earth 22 m). Ground features were read at the local ground height. A roof read off the 20 m ground grid of top_annot.jpg sits about 3.5 m too far east at x = 3390 (the roofs are drawn 3 percent larger than the grid: roof height over ground height, 255 m camera range), so the terminal is not 5 m east of its Earth footprint: its roof reads 3378..3402 (eaves included) on the rectified view and the app poly is 3378..3400.
